title: Glossary
description: plugin/glossary/terms.yaml (the plugin's terms) and evals/glossary.yaml (a repo's own terms). The explainer's only source of words: the dashboard, the CLI and the PR comment all read it. docs/EXPLAINER.md is the contract; litmustest validate enforces the rules beyond shape.

term.description: The term as people read it.

aliases.description: Other spellings the product or people use. Unique across all terms.

short.description: Layer 1: what it means, in 20 words or fewer. Another term is linked as [[id]].

why.description: Why it matters, in one sentence.

good.description: What good looks like. The only place a template's fixed numbers may come from.

here.description: Layer 2: what it means here, per source. The first variant for the source whose when holds and whose facts all resolve is shown.

when.description: A condition over the source's facts.

next.description: Next steps; the first whose when holds is shown. The last has no when.

learn_more.description: The Master Class chapter with the long form.
